capabilities: visualize skill progress with progress bars
associate notes to skills via skill and skill-progress frontmatter fields
drag progress bars to adjust progress manually
organize skills into categories and parent-child hierarchies
scan skills and notes across all open vaults
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English). Manual installation instructions are provided alongside community-plugin installation.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view for tracking progress across skills and the notes that relate to them.
summary: Skill progress dashboard that visualizes learning-skill progress bars, auto-links notes via skill/skill-progress YAML fields, and lets you drag to adjust progress.
